priority_updates.title: Which U.S. state will ask a court to halt further development of ChatGPT over safety concerns in September 2026?
priority_updates.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official state court filings or announcements by state authorities, corroborated by reliable news reporting. Qualifying Event : During September 2026, a U.S. state formally asks a court to stop OpenAI from further developing ChatGPT until safety safeguards are established. The request itself resolves the question; the court need not grant it. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the U.S. state making the request.

priority_updates.title: Which national team will lead UEFA Nations League Group A1 after the matches on September 28, 2026?

Resolution : Identify the national team ranked first in UEFA Nations League Group A1 after all matches played on September 28, 2026, have concluded. Apply UEFA's official tiebreaking rules if teams are level on points. Accepted Answer Format : The country name of the first-placed national team.

priority_updates.title: Who will Aston Martin announce as Lance Stroll's teammate for the 2027 Formula One season?
priority_updates.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Aston Martin's official announcement confirming its complete race-driver lineup for the 2027 Formula One season, corroborated by Formula One or reputable news reporting. Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the driver named alongside Lance Stroll in the first such announcement published by December 31, 2026. A confirmed race-seat contract is sufficient; the driver need not have competed in a 2027 race. Reserve, test, and advisory roles do not qualify. Accepted Answer Format : The driver's full name.

priority_updates.title: Which country will end China's gold-medal bid in men's football at the 2026 Asian Games?

Resolution : Identify the opposing national team in the match that eliminates China from contention for the men's football gold medal. Any subsequent bronze-medal match is excluded.
